skill_name: Compare and contrast the characteristics of two Android operating systems
workflow: Android 9.0 (Pie) and Android 10.0 (Q) are two versions of the Android operating system, released in 2018 and 2019 respectively. Both operating systems feature an improved user interface and enhanced security features, but Android 10.0 (Q) adds new features such as gesture navigation, dark mode, support for foldable and 5G devices, improved privacy settings, and more.
